intro: Senior Advisors are upperclassmen who have worked on at least three projects. Each brings a specialty in part of the diligence process. They hold office hours for analysts, help Project Leads scope engagements and keep them on track, and mentor new Research Leads one-on-one. The executive board also serves as Senior Advisors.

academy.title: RG Academy
academy.body: Two Senior Advisors lead RG Academy, a month-long intensive for each new analyst class. It covers the research resources available to members, how to source and run expert calls, our slide-making standards, and how to turn research into insight.
